result.rationale: Corex is upstream E&P, not infrastructure, and BCI's inventory line does not prove direct legal equity.

identityResolution.predecessorAliases: Amarone Oil & Gas Ltd.; incorporated 2007-04, renamed 2012-03; commonly Corex
identityResolution.holdingSuccessor: No public parent, merger or successor found.
identityResolution.boundary: One upstream platform; wells, units, batteries, waterfloods and interests are assets, not PortCos.

owners.stake: Undisclosed inventory exposure; direct equity unproven
All CDPQ-held shares; total stake undisclosed

owners.organization: Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec
owners.stake: All direct shares sold; percentage not restated

ownershipResolution.conclusion: Do not record BCI as legal owner: no holder, vehicle, security, stake or acquisition is disclosed. Azimuth remains the public sponsor; the cap table is private.

operatingResolution.business: Private junior producer focused primarily on Manitoba light oil.
operatingResolution.customersEndMarkets: Commodity markets; no infrastructure-service contracts disclosed.
operatingResolution.footprint: Southwestern Manitoba; Cecil-area Alberta interests sold in 2026.
operatingResolution.scale: Last public figure was about 7,200 boe/d at 2021-10-31; no current total found.
operatingResolution.status: Active; Manitoba approved Corex projects in 2023-2026 and listed August 2026 battery applications.

infrastructureQualification.reason: Producing commodity reserves is not infrastructure; extraction permits do not create regulated or contracted infrastructure cash flow.
infrastructureQualification.contractedRegulatedOrMidstreamBasis: None found. Field facilities serve own production; no third-party tariffed pipeline, storage, terminal or standalone midstream revenue found.

acquisitionExitCheck.BCIEntry: First inventory appearance was in the 2021-04-01/2022-03-31 window, not 2025; no direct acquisition evidence found.
acquisitionExitCheck.CDPQDisposition: On 2022-06-08 an Azimuth-controlled LP acquired all CDPQ-held common shares.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterAssetSale: Cecil-area interests sold to Ribbon Creek Resources in 2026-05; not a platform transfer.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterPlatformEvents: No later platform sale, merger, recapitalization, bankruptcy or disclosed ownership transfer found through 2026-08-18.

milestones.event: First BCI I&RR inventory appearance; exposure type undisclosed.
CDPQ sold all direct shares to an Azimuth-controlled LP.
Cecil interests sold to Ribbon Creek; Manitoba operations continued.

beforeAfterChanges.focus: Alberta drilling -> primarily Manitoba light-oil E&P
beforeAfterChanges.succession: BCI succeeded CDPQ -> buyer was an Azimuth-controlled LP

excludedOrDuplicateCandidates: Corex wells, units, batteries, waterfloods and interests are operating assets.
Azimuth Corex Limited Partnership may be related, but no primary link to the unnamed 2022 buyer was found.
unresolvedQuestions: What security and holder caused the BCI inventory position?

recommendedListAction.ownerMutation: Remove active BCI ownership; retain only an unverified-exposure note.
recommendedListAction.reason: Fails the infrastructure test and direct BCI equity is unsupported.
